campaign.title: Hard-M1 complete high-radical small-t signed contraction gate

resource_policy.computation_policy: No numerical theorem evidence is planned. Bounded exact algebra, hashing, or finite falsification may be used only as a mechanical control.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete literal hard-M1 high-radical small-t aggregate be bounded by L^(3/2)X^epsilon for every shell and both signs, can a strict owner-compatible signed sector be proved, or does one fresh actual-coefficient mechanism have an exact capacity or self-return obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: |sum_(s>L, mu^2(s)=1, 1<=t<ceil(sqrt L)) C_(L,X)^sigma(st^2)e(sigma t sqrt(Xs))| <<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon, with one absolute value after the complete aggregate and C_(L,X)^sigma(r)=sum_(h|r, h asymp L, r/h odd, 4h<r/h<16h)chi_4(r/h)a_(L,X)^(lit,sigma)(h,r/h).
quantities: The actual coefficient retains the dyadic cutoff, Phi, W, normalized powers, profiles, floors, stars and half weights, strict edges, hard sample, both signs, real-X crossings and endpoints, and zero extension.
Round 181 proves exact product coordinates and pays s<=L and the disjoint sector s>L, t>=ceil(sqrt L) absolutely at L^(3/2)X^epsilon.
The complete small-t coefficient-insensitive capacity is L^2X^epsilon, already on t=1, against target L^(3/2)X^epsilon; the missing gain is L^(1/2).
A uniform fixed-t (L^2/t^2)^(3/4) estimate is sufficient but strictly stronger and is not the owner.
Partial Mobius and shifted-correlation statements are mechanisms only; they must retain both cutoffs, the literal coefficient, endpoints, and a proved connector to the complete aggregate.
Success first closes only the hard signed cone; smooth direct M1 and every M2/global owner remain separate.
The internal exponent is 1/3, the accepted external benchmark is 0.3144831759740614..., and the target is 1/4.

completion_criteria: Receive a direct actual-coefficient attack on the complete small-t aggregate, with both signs, all shells, endpoints, t=1, and one final absolute value.
Derive the exact partial-Mobius kernel with both inequalities and decide whether a target-scale truncation yields a smaller core or self-returns.
Derive the exact fixed-row shifted-correlation sufficient condition, restore its powers, and audit its relation to the old PSC and delta-Kloosterman deficit.
Receive a statement-only independent rederivation of capacity, false controls, the Mobius kernel, and the first missing relation.
Select the narrowest proof, strict sector, or rigorous mechanism no-go without changing the frozen owner or pivoting.
Review coefficient/product/endpoint algebra, power/self-return and PSC overlap, blind post-unmask consistency, and owner/exponent scope.
Formalize any stable finite algebraic kernel before a State Patch.
Apply no graph change without a mechanically valid State Patch, exact inverse, post-application audit, and GREEN validation matrix.
Close under exactly one label: hard_m1_small_t_target, strict_hard_m1_small_t_sector, or small_t_signed_mechanism_capacity_or_self_return_no_go.

closing_assessment.main_result: The actual chi_4(G)-phase progression and exact zero-extended literal step-two BV prove the large-gcd non-half-integer-resonant primitive-ray incidence sector at L^(3/2)X^epsilon, improving its L^(7/4) incidence envelope. The exact small-gcd/near-resonant complement contains all t=1 and remains open. Target-scale partial Mobius truncation self-returns to the full product wave; fixed-row Fejer correlation remains an unproved stronger sufficient mechanism distinct from PSC.
